reuse.why: Extends the shared getScheduledAmount and computes the tolerance with the existing getApproxNumberThreshold from #shared/rules rather than re-deriving 7.5%.

duplication.why: The approximate rule is written once inside getScheduledAmount; call sites only pass their op.

placement.why: The rule sits in shared/schedules.ts where the ranged worst-case rule already lives, used by server and client alike.

scope.why: Only the helper, the planning call sites that need the op, and tests; display-only call sites that show 'Approximately X' are left alone.

maintainability.why: One definition, but the op is an optional third positional argument after a boolean (`getScheduledAmount(x, false, op)`), so a planning caller can silently omit it.

one_place.where: getScheduledAmount in packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts; api-models, forecast, schedule-template, schedules app, preview and Balance.tsx all pass their op to it
